_why: Copy to user://ai_config.json (the Dialogue & microphone page writes it) or, in source runs, res://ai_config.json (gitignored). Missing keys fall back to world/ai/ai_config.gd DEFAULTS. See docs/ALPHA_AI_AND_PORTABILITY.md.

llm._provider: openai = any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, llama.cpp http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1); anthropic = Anthropic Messages API (https://api.anthropic.com/v1)

stt._provider: off = no microphone (type to talk); local = Whisper server at url (tools/ai/stt_server.sh, raw WAV POST, JSON {text}); openai = OpenAI-compatible {base_url}/audio/transcriptions
stt._mode: vad = open mic with voice activity detection; ptt = hold T (desktop) / left B (VR); off
stt._mic_source: Linux PipeWire source name for the mic (pactl list sources short); null = wivrn.source in the headset, system default on desktop

tts._provider: none = local Ponese only; openai = {base_url}/audio/speech (response_format wav, voice = per-pony openai_voice or this voice); gradio = a MOSS-TTS-PNY Gradio host at remote_url called directly; moss = local moss-tts at url; remote = Gradio via tools/ai/tts_proxy.sh at proxy_url (developer)
tts._voice_mode: ponese = all local; auto = character TTS, local Ponese for unvoiced ponies; tts = force TTS. Failed TTS falls back to Ponese unless chatter_fallback is false.

player_approaches._note: One random nearby pony may approach on a 30-second opportunity. Roughly 3-6 minutes with available company; busy, unreachable and cooling-down ponies wait. No LLM planning; greeting shares the automatic-dialogue budget.

lip_sync._engine: auto = mouth shapes from the built-in recogniser first; rhubarb = skip it and use Rhubarb Lip Sync (or loudness)
lip_sync._rhubarb_path: optional absolute path to the Rhubarb Lip Sync executable; see bin/rhubarb/README.md
